notes.source: The glyphs a ported component draws, taken from the very modules the site imports (`lucide-react`). `npm run vectors:generate` writes Compose `ImageVector`s from the same source, so an icon cannot be redrawn by hand or substituted with the nearest Material one (ADR-0100).
notes.gate: `npm run check:vectors` fails a stale output. `npm run check:parity` fails a ported component that imports a lucide icon with no vector here, or draws an icon the site does not.
